column1: # The tree checks: instruments that scan the tree, each with its self-test
# first. tools/run-checks runs one tier of them at once; tools/leg-floor
# counts the rows, so a row that never ran fails the leg. Columns:
# is the configuration). Tiers: routine (make test), full (make test-full adds
# them). Each self-test runs before its tree scan, in one row, because the
# dangerous result for a scan is a clean report from a scan that stopped working.
